title: FIM 逐层 Rank 映射

standard.summary: 由 FIM 扫描器一键写回的逐层精确 rank 映射（JSON：{完整层路径: rank}）。
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: An exact per-layer rank map written back by the FIM scanner in one click (JSON: {full layer path: rank}).
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: 由 FIM 扫描器一键写回的逐层精确 rank 映射（JSON：{完整层路径: rank}）。仅当 Rank 分配策略=fim_profile 时生效。一般不需要手动编辑。

advanced_en.principle: Per-layer exact rank mapping written back by the FIM scanner in one click (JSON: {full layer path: rank}). Only takes effect when Rank allocation policy = fim_profile. Manual editing is normally unnecessary.
